suggestions.topic: EIP-8037/8038 final decision and Hoodi Glamsterdam fork date
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #103 explicitly deferred this decision to ACDE Thursday. ACDT #104 should follow up on ACDE's outcome, finalize client coordination for January 2027 target, and lock in Hoodi testnet date.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam audit findings mitigation status update
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #103 identified 200+ affected contracts across ChainSecurity, Dedaub, and EF internal audits. Outreach to L2/app teams is ongoing (Rahul assigned). Need status on affected protocol fixes and remaining coordination before mainnet.

suggestions.topic: Process improvements: invariant documentation and automated breakage analysis
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #103 surfaced major process gaps. Two specs PRs (#3948, #3982) on deployed-idiom invariants need review/merge. Marius proposed publishing an EIP documenting stable vs. expected-to-change invariants. Agent-swarm analysis will be run systematically going forward.

ACDT #100 requested confirmation of devnet-2 scope (SETCODEFROM, data repricing EIP-8279, nonce bump EIP-8253, deactivate self-destruct) for next call, but it was not addressed in #101-103. If this devnet remains active, scope needs locking.

suggestions.topic: Heze devnet-2 status and CL feature branch readiness
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #102 left shorter slots as a feature branch pending majority client agreement, deferred to ACDC. Heze devnet-2 planning (FOCIL, remove eth1data, disallow 0x00 validators) needs update on client readiness and launch timing.

suggestions.topic: Builder onboarding fix (PR #5736) merge status and Hoodi shadow fork readiness
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #102 approved builder onboarding fix (0x0B-prefixed deposits) for merge 'this week'. ACDT #103 did not confirm merge. Hoodi shadow fork was planned pending client releases; need update on release status and shadow fork timeline.

suggestions.topic: Consensus-specs PRs for ePBS: envelope signatures and GetPayload gossip check
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #102 assigned Sam (Nimbus) to clarify envelope signatures are unverifiable during backfill, and Nico (Lodestar) to open GetPayload transaction count gossip check PR. No confirmation in #103; likely completed async but worth quick check-in.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7870 hardware specs update for Glamsterdam
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #100 identified EIP-7870 sequential read/write specs (500 MB/s) are too low for Glamsterdam; jochem recommended 2000 MB/s. Decision made to keep as living document with fork-specific history. Update needs to be completed.
